Two Pointers · O(n) · No hash map, no nested loop.

g.text: 2 + 31 = 33 > 22 — too big, move right pointer left.
2 + 24 = 26 > 22 — too big, move right pointer left.
2 + 19 = 21 < 22 — too small, move left pointer right.
4 + 19 = 23 > 22 — too big, move right pointer left.
4 + 15 = 19 < 22 — too small, move left pointer right.
